subject: Topology labeling and evidence pulse for Veridian - SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ
messages:
From: Maria Velásquez <maria.velasquez@secureassess.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com
Cc: audit-inquiries@secureassess.com
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: topology snapshot + labeled demarcation for Private deploy (Veridian)

Hi Diego,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of Veridian Health's SOC 2 + SIG review we need a compact set of deliverables that map your Private deployment network posture to the CAIQ/SIG questions. Specifically we need: 

- A single-page, labeled topology diagram that clearly shows: tenant data plane, control plane overlay, KMS boundary, and egress inspection points.
- A segmentation matrix that lists subnet/CIDR, purpose, and what breaks the tenant boundary (egress gateways, NAT, private link).
- A short narrative (1 page) describing how the control plane is isolated and fallback behavior when a dedicated pool is unavailable.
- Any evidence artifacts (audit log samples, flow log example, key wrap policy snippet) you can share.

Can you confirm whether you can provide the labeled diagram and segmentation matrix by Friday 2026-10-23? If you prefer a short sync to walk through topology first, I can do 30 minutes on Thursday 10/22 (PST).

Also: please attach files as PDFs/PNGs and avoid large raw exports. We will map items back to the CAIQ and SIG answers on our side.

Best,
Maria Velásquez
Senior Assessor — SecureAssess
(attachment: request-checklist.pdf - doc)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com
To: Maria Velásquez <maria.velasquez@secureassess.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com, soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-10-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: topology snapshot + labeled demarcation for Private deploy (Veridian)

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear list.

We can provide the labeled topology and segmentation matrix by the requested date. I'm attaching a first-pass topology (network_diagram_v1.png) and a segmentation matrix CSV (segmentation_matrix_v1.xlsx) for your intake team to review.

Quick notes on items you asked about:
- Control plane: private control plane runs in a customer VPC when Veridian opts for Private. There's a customer-managed transit layer; the control plane APIs authenticate with mTLS and are restricted to the control VPC CIDR.
- Egress: we publish an egress breakpoints list — outbound traffic from tenant workloads passes through an egress gateway where we apply network-level filtering and egress NAT in the customer's region.
- KMS boundary: keys are in the customer's KMS (BYOK) for Private deployments; key usage is audited and logs can be exported.

Next steps: Kim and Soojin (cc'd) will take point on redlining the diagram and drafting a short narrative. Happy to take the Thursday 10/22 sync if Maria wants to walk through the topology live.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
(attachment: network_diagram_v1.png - image)
(attachment: segmentation_matrix_v1.xlsx - spreadsheet)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com, Maria Velásquez <maria.velasquez@secureassess.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: topology snapshot + labeled demarcation for Private deploy (Veridian)

Thanks — adding a couple of clarifications and attaching a cleaner control-plane overlay: controlplane_overlay_v2.svg.

Clarifications to call out on the labelled diagram:
- Tenant data plane is fully customer VPC-resident; we only host the model serving runtime on dedicated pods that are attached to that VPC via a private peering interface when Private is selected.
- The control plane is logically segregated: control-plane traffic is routed over a management VPC with strict ACLs; control agents use short-lived certs (rotated daily) — mention this in the 1-page narrative.
- Egress breakpoints: show two egress tiers on the diagram — (1) regional egress gateway for outbound internet, (2) cross-account private link for SaaS integrations.

I've attached controlplane_overlay_v2.svg and will convert to PNG for the final. We will produce a 1-page narrative and a CAIQ mapping PDF (draft) by Thursday COB.

Attachments: controlplane_overlay_v2.svg (attachment - svg)

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Principal Security Architect — Redwood Inference

From: Maria Velásquez <maria.velasquez@secureassess.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com, soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-10-22T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: topology snapshot + labeled demarcation for Private deploy (Veridian)

Diego / team — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few follow-ups before we map to CAIQ/SIG: 

1) Can you include a small inset on the diagram that shows the tenant failover path if a dedicated pool in-region is unavailable (for example: control-plane fallback to multi-region control, model variant fallback rules).
2) For KMS: a one-paragraph snippet showing key ownership/rotation/attestation will suffice for now.
3) Evidence: a 7-day sample of flow logs (redacted) and a sample of a key-usage audit record (timestamp + key-id + operation) would close several SIG checks. Redacted logs are fine; we only need examples.

Also: could you provide the labelled PNG (so our reviewers don't have to open SVG) and a draft mapping doc that ties the topology items to CAIQ sections (network boundary, data path, key management)? If you can get the labeled PNG and draft mapping to me by COB Thursday 2026-10-22 or during the 30m sync, that would be excellent.

Finally, please add a filename convention on the attachments (e.g., VERIDIAN_topology_v2.png) so we can keep artifacts organized in the evidence binder.

Thanks — I can take 30 minutes at 10:00am PST on Thursday if that works.

Maria
Senior Assessor — SecureAssess
(attachment: sig-checklist-crosswalk.xlsx - spreadsheet)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com

Maria — thanks, confirmed. Deliverables we are sending now:

- VERIDIAN_topology_v2_labelled.png (attachment: network_diagram_v2_labelled.png) — includes tenant failover inset and explicit control-plane demarcation.
- veridian_caiq_mapping_draft.pdf (attachment) — links topology elements to CAIQ sections (Network, Data Protection, Key Management).
- redacted_flow_sample_7d.json (we'll add to the Drive folder) — sample flow records (redacted IPs).
- key_usage_sample.txt — sample key usage audit record (redacted).

Kim (CC) will be the owner for the final CAIQ mapping and can coordinate any deeper technical Q&A. We are slotting a sync at 10:00am PST on Thursday 10/22 — invite sent separately.

Action items: 
- Kim: finalize CAIQ mapping and drop the PDF in the Drive folder.
- Soojin: export a PNG of the overlay and add the failover inset.
- Diego: provide sample logs and confirm redaction.

If anything else pops up during your review Maria, flag it and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
